root_cause: The Qore core RPM compiles these optional XML branches without the external XML module. Installing XML intentionally makes the loader select the packaged source so XML support becomes available. The same source-fallback behavior was already approved for QUnit, ProviderIndexUtil and HttpServer; these seven named features are additional scope.
controls: Each of the seven features imports with no diagnostic before installing XML, and imports successfully with its exact XML source-fallback diagnostic afterwards, on Fedora, Leap and AlmaLinux. Transitive warnings are checked against the same seven exact complete messages. No filters or loader changes are proposed.

approval.source: Explicit user reply in this session
approval.scope: Seven exact optional-XML source fallbacks; warnings remain visible; no loader or checker changes.
